ITEM 1 | Pale cream-to-tan small oval beans, soft-skinned, clustered in a loose mound on the upper-left of the plate with a light sheen, about 9 cm across and 1.5 cm high, covering roughly 12% of the plate | 110
ITEM 2 | Pinkish-orange fish fillet portion with a darker charred-looking skin edge along one side and flaked pale-pink flesh on top sprinkled with small green flecks, about 7 cm long, 4 cm wide and 2 cm thick, sitting beside the beans | 120
ITEM 3 | Cauliflower florets, cream-white with golden-brown roasted edges and dark char spots, bite-sized pieces about 2-4 cm each, arranged in a cluster on the lower-left of the plate, slightly glossy from oil, covering roughly 20% of the plate, about 2.5 cm high | 150
ITEM 4 | Mixed fresh salad greens, dark green spinach-like and lighter leaves, some with reddish-purple edges, mostly flat and slightly glossy, piled on the upper-right of the plate covering roughly 25% of the plate, about 2 cm high, topped with a few dark reddish-purple bits and small pale crumbly pieces | 70
ITEM 5 | Avocado, pale green flesh with darker green skin edge, cut into two wedge-shaped slices about 8-10 cm long and 3 cm wide, smooth and slightly glossy, sitting along the lower-right edge of the plate | 130
ITEM 6 | Small pale crumbly garnish pieces and dark reddish-brown bits (dried fruit or seed clusters) scattered among the salad greens, dry looking, about 1 cm pieces | 10
